gui.chatencryption.encryption_warning.he: To Encrypt or Not to Encrypt
gui.chatencryption.encryption_warning.co:
Encryption can be used to keep your chats private and secure. However, you must fully understand its capabilities and limitations before using it.

We recommend you read more about how encryption works before you start using it.
gui.chatencryption.encryption_config.key:
§lEncryption Key§r
A key used to encrypt and decrypt messages. Must be a string of characters. You can generate a random key, or derive one from a passphrase below.
gui.chatencryption.encryption_config.pas:
§lPassphrase§r
If specified, the key will be derived from this passphrase.
This algorithm does not support passphrases.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.chatencry: Replicates the chat encryption feature of No Chat Reports for 1.21.5+. Encrypt and decrypt chat messages using a shared secret key, compatible with No Chat Reports encryption.
algorithm.chatencryption.aes_cfb8_base64: AES/CFB8 mode with no padding. Message is split into blocks, each XORed with the previous one. The result is Base64-encoded and scrambled using the Base64R algorithm.
algorithm.chatencryption.aes_gcm_base64: AES in Galois/Counter Mode. Provides authenticity as well as confidentiality. The result is Base64-encoded and scrambled using the Base64R algorithm.
algorithm.chatencryption.aes_ecb_base64: AES in Electronic Codebook mode. Insecure in principle and not recommended for actual use. The result is Base64-encoded and scrambled using the Base64R algorithm.
algorithm.chatencryption.caesar.name: Caesar cipher
algorithm.chatencryption.caesar: Caesar cipher. Shifts every character by a fixed amount. Very insecure and easy to break.
